messages.subject: Project Sable - any update on the rent deposit deed?
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Separate from Quartz - on Project Sable, has the landlord's solicitor come back on the rent deposit deed yet? The tenant is chasing us for completion of the lettings and I want to keep that one moving too.

Thanks,
Isla
